```{text}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Injecting CSS and JS to handle section toggling
cat('
<style>
.toggle-btn {
  background-color: #f0f0f0;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-right: 10px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.toggle-btn.active {
  background-color: #007bff;
  color: white;
  border-color: #0056b3;
}
.hidden-section {
  display: none;
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const sec1 = document.getElementById("section-1");
  const sec2 = document.getElementById("section-2");
  const btn1 = document.getElementById("btn-sec1");
  const btn2 = document.getElementById("btn-sec2");

  function showSection1() {
    sec1.classList.remove("hidden-section");
    sec2.classList.add("hidden-section");
    btn1.classList.add("active");
    btn2.classList.remove("active");
  }

  function showSection2() {
    sec2.classList.remove("hidden-section");
    sec1.classList.add("hidden-section");
    btn2.classList.add("active");
    btn1.classList.remove("active");
  }

  btn1.addEventListener("click", showSection1);
  btn2.addEventListener("click", showSection2);
  
  // Listen for TOC clicks to auto-switch views
  document.querySelectorAll(".toc-actions a, #TOC a").forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      const href = this.getAttribute("href");
      if (href.startsWith("#section-1") || href.startsWith("#subsection-1")) {
        showSection1();
      } else if (href.startsWith("#section-2") || href.startsWith("#subsection-2")) {
        showSection2();
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>
')
```

<!-- Navigation Buttons -->
<button id="btn-sec1" class="toggle-btn active">Show Section 1</button>
<button id="btn-sec2" class="toggle-btn">Show Section 2</button>

::: {#section-1}
## Section 1

This is the content of the first section. 

### Subsection 1.1
This subsection will also show up beautifully in the TOC!
:::

::: {#section-2 .hidden-section}
## Section 2

This is the content of the second section, hidden by default.

### Subsection 2.1
This will also appear in the TOC, and clicking it will automatically toggle this view open.
:::
